reponse:
I don't know yet what Corvane will charge in 2027, because nothing is final.

- **Planning assumption:** The pricing memo assumes the Corvane per-item ACH fee stays at $0.08 in 2027. The current agreement runs until March 31, 2027, and Marcus is to open renewal talks in November [1]. The memo also mentions a threshold at $0.10, but the passage is cut off before it says what happens above that [1].
- **Current cost:** October's invoice was $14,212.40 for 177,655 ACH items [6]. That works out to about $0.08 per item, my own arithmetic from those two figures.
- **Risk of an increase:** On Nov 16 Marcus said Corvane's relationship manager hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 file rejection. He added that nothing is on paper yet [5]. The renewal call moved to the week of Nov 23 [5].

Once the renewal call has happened, the #finance thread is the place to look for a real number.
